PhoneNight.dc.html.title: 6 · Game night on a phone (theme prop: Midnight or Daylight)

s1.text: Board 1 is the real thing. Settings: seven themes (Daylight and Paper are true light themes, measured for contrast). Equity: type two cards (Th9h) and press Enter to add a player; arrow keys step the turn card; Escape returns to the flop. Strategy: spot map and plan builder. Training seats: Heads-up duel, Full hand. Board 6 has a theme prop. Many side-rail items are placeholders by design. Everything is sample data.
